claims.text: At a May 2025 UAP Disclosure Fund hearing Elizondo presented an image he described as a disc-shaped object 600-1,000 feet in diameter; analysts including Mick West identified it as an irrigation circle.
His second memoir, 'Reckoning: The Unspoken Truth about UFOs and the Urgency of Now', is scheduled for publication by HarperCollins' Mudlark imprint in August 2026.

b.label: Presidential directive waiving UAP-related nondisclosure agreements

edges.label: the paradigm case the waiver addresses
edges.note: Elizondo is the archetype of a former official constrained by prepublication review and secrecy obligations; the ODNI memorandum waives 'agreements, oaths, or commitments' for disclosure to government investigators, not to publishers.
